arbitrary.text: Combining collagen-producing fibroblasts with a matrix already pictured beside living fibroblasts felt somewhat redundant, although it clarified their arrangement as tissue.

continue.text: I would continue to see how separate myoblasts develop into muscle, though I would hope for more meaningful choices than the final linear sequence offered.
